answers: The backup file is created by `pg_dump`, run through `docker exec app-db`, inside the script /usr/local/sbin/backup-app-db.
The script's `find` command deletes files matching app-*.dump in the backup directory that are older than 7 days (-mtime +6).
The restore test should happen in an isolated PostgreSQL 17 container named app-db-restore-test, on the `none` network, not in production.
